property_summary: After any sequence of addToBalance calls, the sum of all individual deposits made by a user must equal that user's recorded balance; the mutant violates this by overwriting the balance instead of accumulating deposits.
change_summary: Replace `userBalance[msg.sender] = add_uint256(userBalance[msg.sender], msg.value);` with `userBalance[msg.sender] = msg.value;` so old balance is overwritten.
